title: Live updates: Crypto's big election gamble faces voters as Democrats gain ground
summary: Voters are choosing who will represent them in the House, Senate and state-wide seats.

title: What voters said about their views on crypto
summary: A CoinDesk-commissioned poll from April sheds light on how voters — who aren't necessarily part of the crypto sector — view this industry.

title: What happens if North Korea steals Wall Street's tokenized assets next
summary: The $6.3 billion Binance hack showed how quickly cryptocurrencies can disappear on blockchain rails. Tokenized securities may offer better recourse than crypto after a theft, but the markets around them can still break down when stress hits.

title: CFTC gets into legal clash over stock perps after having cleared path for crypto version
summary: A group backed by Citadel Securities and other firms sued the U.S. derivatives regulator for opening a path for perps that it argued belong in the SEC's hands.

title: Justin Sun seeks sanctions against Trump-linked World Liberty Financial over UAE ties
summary: The Tron founder says World Liberty failed to disclose its UAE ties until months into his lawsuit over $45 million in WLFI tokens.
